tools.name: latency
tools.description: RTT samples (1–10) against the Graphai Vercel /api/ping (same idea as check-wireguard 1–10 path sample).

tools.name: speed
tools.description: Download throughput from Vercel /api/speed (Mbps).

tools.name: my_ip
tools.description: GET /my-ip on the Graphai Vercel webservice — public IP seen by the edge.

tools.name: my_ip_geolocation
tools.description: GET /my-ip-geolocation — IP plus Vercel geo headers (country, city, lat/lon, ASN).

tools.name: ipv4
tools.description: IPv4 family check (check-wireguard GET /api/ip?fam=ipv4 equivalent on this host).

tools.name: ipv6
tools.description: IPv6 family check (GET /api/ip?fam=ipv6).

tools.name: path_sample
tools.description: Path sample 1–10 RTT probes (check-wireguard Sampling the tunnel).

tools.name: network_quality
tools.description: Apple-style networkQuality: idle pings plus download/upload against /api/nq-*.

tools.name: http2
tools.description: HTTP/2 RTT samples 1–60 against Vercel /api/ping.

tools.name: http3
tools.description: HTTP/3-advertised RTT samples 1–60 against /api/nq-ping (alt-svc h3).

tools.name: video_stream
tools.description: Video streaming stall/bitrate proxy 1–120 downloads of /api/probe.

tools.name: stats
tools.description: Live probe JSON like check-wireguard /api/stats for this Graphai origin.

tools.name: check_wg_ip
tools.description: Proxy check-wireguard.graphai.eu GET /api/ip.

tools.name: check_wg_stats
tools.description: Proxy check-wireguard.graphai.eu GET /api/stats.

tools.name: queries
tools.description: Proxy check-wireguard ClickHouse query catalog or a named query (by_country, scans_recent, …).

tools.name: login
tools.description: Start Clerk login shared with check-wireguard.graphai.eu. Returns a URL to open, then poll login_status.

tools.name: login_status
tools.description: Poll a Clerk MCP ticket until status=ready (JWT on the ticket).

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Clerk session + KPI subscription on the shared check-wireguard profile.

tools.name: subscribe
tools.description: Create a NOWPayments invoice: min of €5 or 0.0001 BTC. Prints a terminal QR of the BTC address plus web links.

tools.name: subscribe_status
tools.description: Poll NOWPayments payment_id after subscribe.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: login · Public sink: network_quality.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: login · Public sink: network_quality

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
